components.css: .ds-card { font-family: Manrope, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 22px; padding: 16px 16px 16px; color: var(--ink); max-width: 420px; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 4px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -.015em; } .ds-card-sub { margin: 1px 4px 12px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink-3); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-tiles { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 8px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-tiles li { padding: 10px; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--surface-2); } .ds-tile-l { display: block; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink-3); } .ds-tile-v { display: block; margin-top: 2px; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 800; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-up { color: var(--up); } .ds-down { color: var(--down); }

components.name: Status pill
components.description: A dot and a word; appears only when there is something to say.

components.css: .ds-status { font-family: Manrope, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 26px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; background: var(--surface-3); color: var(--ink-2); } .ds-status::before { content: ""; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; } .ds-ok { background: rgba(34,229,139,.12); color: var(--up); } .ds-warn { background: rgba(245,184,75,.12); color: var(--warn); } .ds-err { background: rgba(255,92,115,.13); color: var(--down); }

components.name: Filter chip
components.description: Timeline filters with a count; selected inverts to ink.
components.css: .ds-chip { font-family: Manrope, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); color: var(--ink-2); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; transition: background-color .2s ease, color .2s ease, border-color .2s ease; } .ds-chip i { font-style: normal; min-width: 20px; height: 18px; padding: 0 6px; border-radius: 999px; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; background: var(--surface-3); color: var(--ink-3); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; } .ds-chip:hover { color: var(--ink); border-color: var(--ink-3); } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--ink); border-color: var(--ink); color: var(--bg); } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] i { background: rgba(11,14,20,.14); color: var(--bg); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
A ledger opened on a phone, several times a day, usually in a dim room. The screen is nearly black and the numbers are the brightest thing on it. Nothing glows for decoration: the only saturated colour on a healthy screen is the sign of a money move. Surfaces are told apart by a half-step of tone and a hairline, never by shadow.

The system is dense but calm. One column, 560px at most, built from rounded cards stacked with even gaps. Each card answers one question and states its own caveats (how many observations, which source failed, which figure is an estimate) next to the number it qualifies. Type is one family, Manrope, pushed to its heavy weights for figures and titles and kept at semibold for everything that explains them.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black canvas, tonal surfaces, hairline borders, no resting shadows.
One typeface; weight and size carry hierarchy; all figures are tabular.
Green and red mean "money went up / down" and nothing else.
Every caveat sits beside its number; nothing fails silently.
Mobile first: 44px touch targets, one thumb-reachable tab bar, bottom sheets.

rules.name: The Colour Is Data Rule
rules.body: Green and red appear only on a signed amount or a pass/fail state. A screen with no move and no failure is entirely grey.

rules.name: The Never Colour Alone Rule
rules.body: A gain or loss always carries a sign and an arrow as well as its colour; a status always carries a word.

rules.name: The Tint Rule
rules.body: A signal colour used as a background is the same hue at 7-14% opacity over the surface, with the full-strength hue as text. Solid signal fills do not exist.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number that can change is set with tabular figures, so columns line up and a refreshing value does not jitter.

rules.name: The Money Is Never Cut Rule
rules.body: A balance is never ellipsised. The column widens, the figure shrinks, or the unit drops to a second line.

rules.name: The One-Second Rule
rules.body: The Portfolio tab must stay readable in one second: total, 24h move, chart. It receives no new cards. New facts about the present either join the status line under the hero (and hide themselves when healthy) or go inside an asset row.

rules.name: The One Question Rule
rules.body: A card answers one question, named in its title. A new feature extends the card that already owns its question before it earns a card of its own.

rules.name: The Quiet When Healthy Rule
rules.body: A warning element takes no space while there is nothing to warn about. No "all good" chips.

rules.name: The Flat At Rest Rule
rules.body: Nothing that scrolls with the page casts a shadow. A card that needs emphasis gets a tinted wash at its top edge (the hero) or a tinted border (a notice).

rules.name: The Caveat Line Rule
rules.body: A caveat about a table row ("72% tracked", "deposits priced at that day's market") gets its own line under the row. Beside the symbol it is cut off on a phone.

dos: Do wrap every dollar amount in the privacy blur and set it in tabular figures.
Do pair every gain or loss colour with a sign and an arrow.
Do state the caveat where the number is: sample size in the card sub-line, "inferred" or "estimate" as a tag on the row, missing data in words instead of a zero.
Do keep touch targets at 44px, extending the hit area invisibly when the drawn control is smaller.
Do extend an existing card, the status line or an asset row before adding a card.
Do give every card a loading skeleton, an empty state that says what is missing, and an error state that leaves the rest of the tab usable.
Do give every Analytics card a folded summary line; a card that cannot say its answer in one line is two cards.
donts: Don't use green or red for anything but a signed amount or a pass/fail state.
Don't add resting shadows, gradients as decoration, or a second typeface.
Don't add a card to the Portfolio tab.
Don't show a healthy-state chip; warnings appear only when there is something to say.
Don't ellipsise money, or annualise a return over a period shorter than a year.
Don't go below 11px text or Ink Faint for contrast.
